name: Daily Cruise Business Health & Intelligence Automation

parameters.jsCode:
// 09 Generate Final Email and Sheet Payload const d = $input.first().json; const emailHtml = `

⚓ Odysseus Daily Business Health

Date: ${d.date} | 07:00 AM Executive Briefing

📊 Yesterday's Commercial Performance

Revenue: $${d.performance.revenue.toLocaleString()} | Bookings: ${d.performance.bookings} | Passengers: ${d.performance.passengers}

Average Order Value: $${d.performance.averageOrderValue.toLocaleString()} | Top Cruise: ${d.performance.topCruise}

⚠️ Inventory & Promo Alerts

Capacity Alerts: ${d.capacityAlerts.length} route(s) at critical/sold-out status.

Promo Alerts: ${d.promoAlerts.length} code(s) near limit or expiring soon.

🧠 AI Strategic Insights & Recommendations

${d.aiInsights.replace(/\n/g, '
')}
`; return [{ json: { ...d, emailHtml, sheetRow: { Date: d.date, Revenue: d.performance.revenue, Bookings: d.performance.bookings, Passengers: d.performance.passengers, TopCruise: d.performance.topCruise, CapacityAlertsCount: d.capacityAlerts.length, PromoAlertsCount: d.promoAlerts.length } } }];
